revisions.displayName: Send Slack Message with File Contents
revisions.description: Send slack message with file contents via webhook

changelog.reason: The task sends again (it failed on an undefined variable and still reported success), decodes Encoded content, and fails on any error from Slack

params.description: Found within your webhook integration settings
params.label: Webhook URL
params.helpertext: The incoming webhook URL. It is the credential, so it is never logged
params.name: url

params.label: Channel
params.helpertext: A channel (#builds) or user to post to. Blank, or a webhook from a Slack app (which ignores it), posts to the webhook's own channel
params.name: channel

params.label: Icon
params.helpertext: An emoji such as :rocket: shown as the sender's icon; only legacy custom-integration webhooks use it
params.name: icon

params.label: Username
params.helpertext: The name shown as the sender; only legacy custom-integration webhooks use it
params.name: username

params.label: Message
params.helpertext: A heading shown above the content
params.name: message

params.label: File Content
params.helpertext: The text to post, split into blocks of up to 3000 characters; content past one message (50 blocks) is left out with a note
params.name: content

params.description: Enable if File Content provided is base64 encoded
params.label: Decode File Content
params.helpertext: Content is base64, e.g. a log passed from an earlier task
params.name: encoded

params.label: Context
params.helpertext: A footer line, in Slack's mrkdwn
params.name: context
